project_type: React Native / Expo 51 mobile app + Node.js/Express/MongoDB REST backend, monorepo
language: JavaScript only — no TypeScript, no .ts/.tsx files
build_system: Two independent npm projects. mobile/: Expo CLI. server/: plain Node.js with nodemon for dev. No root-level build script. Windows/PowerShell host.
test_framework: No test runner. Verification is: (a) server starts without crash — 'cd server && node src/server.js', (b) mobile bundle compiles — 'cd mobile && npx expo export --platform android' exits 0.
build_command: server: node src/server.js (from server/ dir) | mobile: npx expo export --platform android (from mobile/ dir)
test_command: server: node src/server.js (watch for 'Server running on port 5000') | mobile: npx expo export --platform android (exits 0 = success)
verification_instructions: 1. Fix Phase 1 bugs first (ConfirmDialog shadowColor, auth.js JWT catch). 2. Add all server models — server must start clean. 3. Add all routes — app.js must import them all. 4. Run 'cd server && node src/server.js' and confirm startup. 5. Run 'cd mobile && npx expo export --platform android' and confirm exit 0.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Expo SDK ~51. API_BASE_URL in mobile is 'http://localhost:5000/api' — mobile service file paths must NOT include '/api' prefix. Server uses ES modules ('type':'module' in package.json) — use import/export, explicit .js extensions. Never write files outside c:\Users\Dell\Desktop\PROWASH.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md. Follow original spec: JS-only, Expo-compatible libs only, no TypeScript, no Firebase/Supabase, SecureStore for JWT token, role-based auth enforced server-side.
key_patterns: Backend: controller functions take (req,res,next), domain errors use 'return next(new AppError(message, statusCode))', success response is 'res.json({ success: true, data: {...} })'. Mobile: screens are functional components, all API calls go through src/services/api.js (axios instance), theme is imported from src/theme/{colors,spacing,typography}.js, existing components (AppButton, AppInput, AppHeader, LoadingView, ErrorView, EmptyState, StatusBadge, ConfirmDialog) cover all standard UI patterns.
directory_structure: PROWASH/ root — mobile/src/{assets,components,constants,context,hooks,navigation,screens/{auth,customer,admin},services,theme,utils} — server/src/{config,controllers,middleware,models,routes,services,utils} — server/scripts/ (seed scripts) — .agents/tasks/phase2-prowash/ (planning artifacts, never committed)
